flow.name: mf-impl-post-parent-pom-upgrade
flow.doc:description: REST entry: map body to vars, delegate to shared pf-upgrade-parent-pom.

sub-flow.name: pf-upgrade-parent-pom
sub-flow.doc:description: Shared: pin matrix connectors in a parent/BOM pom, open PR, notify.

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO START pf-upgrade-parent-pom
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'START - pf-upgrade-parent-pom | repoUrl=' ++ (vars.repoUrl default '(none)') ++ ' | owner=' ++ (vars.owner default '(none)') ++ ' | repo=' ++ (vars.repo default '(none)') ++ ' | env=' ++ (vars.environment default '(none)')]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- (vars.pomPath default (vars.repoCoords.urlPomPath default 'pom.xml')) as String

logger.doc:name: LOG ERROR repo unresolved
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'parent-pom: could not resolve owner/repo | repoUrl=' ++ (vars.repoUrl default '?')]

raise-error.doc:name: RAISE VALIDATION (repo unresolved)
raise-error.description: Provide a valid repoUrl (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>) or owner+repo for the parent/BOM repository.

set-variable.value: #[(if ((vars.branch default '') != '') vars.branch else vars.repoCoords.urlBranch) as String]
set-variable.doc:name: PV SET defaultBranch (explicit/url)

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO resolved coordinates
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'parent-pom resolved | owner=' ++ (vars.repoCoords.owner default '?') ++ ' repo=' ++ (vars.repoCoords.repo default '?') ++ ' branch=' ++ (vars.defaultBranch default '?') ++ ' pomPath=' ++ (vars.pomPath default '?') ++ ' | fromRepoUrl=' ++ (vars.repoUrl default '(none)')]

logger.doc:name: LOG ERROR pom content empty
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'parent-pom: no readable content at ' ++ (vars.pomPath default '?') ++ ' in ' ++ (vars.repoCoords.owner default '?') ++ '/' ++ (vars.repoCoords.repo default '?')]

raise-error.doc:name: RAISE VALIDATION (pom empty)
raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'The pom.xml at "' ++ (vars.pomPath default '?') ++ '" in ' ++ (vars.repoCoords.owner default '?') ++ '/' ++ (vars.repoCoords.repo default '?') ++ ' could not be read (path may be a directory, empty, or too large). Verify pomPath.']

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import fromBase64 from dw::core::Binaries --- (fromBase64((vars.pomResp.content default "") replace /[\r\n\t ]/ with "")) as String {encoding: "UTF-8"}
%dw 2.0 output application/java import rewriteParentPom from dwl::parentPomRewrite --- rewriteParentPom((vars.pomText as String), vars.matrix, (vars.pomPath as String))

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO already compliant
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'parent-pom already meets matrix | ' ++ (vars.repoCoords.owner default '?') ++ '/' ++ (vars.repoCoords.repo default '?') ++ ':' ++ (vars.pomPath default '?')]

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Build parent-pom job record (no change)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import nowUtc from dwl::dates --- { jobId: vars.jobId, kind: "parentPomUpgrade", status: "NO_CHANGE", appName: vars.appName, environment: vars.environment, jiraTicketId: vars.jiraTicketId, pomPath: vars.pomPath, coords: { owner: vars.repoCoords.owner, repo: vars.repoCoords.repo, defaultBranch: vars.defaultBranch }, createdAt: nowUtc(), updatedAt: nowUtc(), completedAt: nowUtc() }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { jobId: vars.jobId, status: "NO_CHANGE", upgraded: false, appName: vars.appName, pomPath: vars.pomPath, edits: [], jiraTicketId: vars.jiraTicketId, jiraUrl: (if ((vars.jiraTicketId default null) != null and (p('jira.baseUrl') default '') != '') ((p('jira.baseUrl') as String) ++ "/browse/" ++ (vars.jiraTicketId as String)) else null), message: ("Parent/BOM already meets the Java 17 matrix; nothing to change in " ++ (vars.pomPath as String)) } filterObject ((value, key) -> value != null)

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { owner: vars.repoCoords.owner, repo: vars.repoCoords.repo, defaultBranch: vars.defaultBranch }
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { headSha: vars.headSha, targetRuntime: vars.matrix.target.runtime, targetJavaVersion: vars.matrix.target.javaVersion }
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- [ { path: (vars.pomPath as String), content: (vars.rewrite.text as String) } ]

%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { warnings: [ ("Parent/BOM connector version upgrade pinning " ++ sizeOf(vars.rewrite.edits default []) ++ " connector(s): " ++ ((vars.rewrite.edits default []) map ((e) -> ((e.artifactId default '?') as String) ++ " " ++ ((e.from default 'unknown') as String) ++ " -> " ++ ((e.to default '?') as String)) joinBy "; ")) ] }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import nowUtc from dwl::dates --- { jobId: vars.jobId, kind: "parentPomUpgrade", status: "PROCESSING", appName: vars.appName, environment: vars.environment, jiraTicketId: vars.jiraTicketId, pomPath: vars.pomPath, coords: vars.coords, createdAt: nowUtc(), updatedAt: nowUtc() }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { jobId: vars.jobId, status: "PR_OPEN", upgraded: true, appName: vars.appName, pomPath: vars.pomPath, branchName: vars.branchName, prUrl: vars.prUrl, prNumber: vars.prNumber, jiraTicketId: vars.jiraTicketId, jiraUrl: (if ((vars.jiraTicketId default null) != null and (p('jira.baseUrl') default '') != '') ((p('jira.baseUrl') as String) ++ "/browse/" ++ (vars.jiraTicketId as String)) else null), edits: (vars.rewrite.edits default []), message: ("Opened PR pinning " ++ sizeOf(vars.rewrite.edits default []) ++ " connector(s) in " ++ (vars.pomPath as String)) } filterObject ((value, key) -> value != null)

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO END pf-upgrade-parent-pom
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - pf-upgrade-parent-pom | upgraded=' ++ (payload.upgraded default false) ++ ' | prUrl=' ++ (vars.prUrl default '(none)')]
